title: 第23章 圣焰龙雀
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
前世网络上的小段子，秦然从来都不屑一顾。

    但此刻用起来，效果却是出奇的好。

    原著中，徐若晗的设定本就是苦恋云江仙无果的可怜妹子。

    如今一朝得到宠幸，开心和幸福都写在了小脸上……

    呼。

    二人之间的温情并未持续很久。

    一道火光忽然从天外疾驰而来，火光一闪，便落在了院落里。

    “龙雀？”秦然挑眉。

    来者是一个形体高挑、身材异常火爆的女人，尤其是那两条大长腿，比例夸张到逆天。

    女人五官容貌无可挑剔，但却不似普通女人那般温婉柔和，而是充斥着一股睥睨与霸道。

    她衣着不多，仅有关键位置贴着华丽耀眼的火甲，其火红色长发上，笼罩着一顶凤凰形态的火焰冠冕。

    这造型，妥妥的御姐。

    而且是那种极具攻击性的御姐！

    “这小说世界的内容，终究是演变成了我高攀不起的样子……”

    【姓名：龙雀】

    【称号：焰妃】

    【境界：二阶天尊】

    【种族：圣焰龙雀（神魔族）】

    【身份：帝器大夏龙雀的守护者】

    【点评：圣焰龙雀一族乃顶尖神魔族之一，后被云族始祖收服，世代守护大夏帝器，如今是第九代守护者】

    原著设定中，大夏唯一帝器大夏龙雀的打造材料来自圣焰龙雀一族，所以帝器命名为大夏龙雀。

    圣焰龙雀一族曾是顶尖神魔族之一，但这一族血脉传承困难，需要上一代圣焰龙雀献祭己身，方才能诞生出下一代。

    每一代皆由龙雀二字命名。

    如今已经来到了第九代！

    云族始祖降伏圣焰龙雀时曾有过约定，若将来有一日云族没落，云族子弟不是龙雀对手时，那两族契约便可解除。

    圣焰龙雀没有了守护帝器的职责，也没有了守卫大夏的责任。

    如今的龙雀，实力轻松碾压秦然，她已经可以摆脱圣焰龙雀族万年来的枷锁，但并未就此离去。

    并非念及万年来的旧情。

    而是同样想要分一杯大夏龙运的羹……

    龙雀周身沐浴着火焰。

    在她到来之后，整个院落里的香槟色玫瑰，肉眼可见的在枯萎。

    她脚下的地面也被灼烧成了黑褐色。

    徐若晗眼底闪过一抹心疼。
content_en:
Qin Ran had never paid attention to the short jokes on the Internet in his previous life.

But when I use it now, the effect is surprisingly good.

In the original work, Xu Ruohan's setting is that of a poor girl who has a bitter love for Yun Jiangxian but to no avail.

Now that I have been favored, joy and happiness are all written on my little face...

Phew.

The tenderness between the two did not last long.

A ray of fire suddenly came from the sky, and the fire flashed and fell in the courtyard.

"Dragon bird?" Qin Ran raised his eyebrows.

The person who came was a tall woman with an extremely hot figure, especially those long legs with exaggerated proportions.

The woman's facial features are impeccable, but they are not as gentle and soft as ordinary women, but full of scorn and domineering.

She doesn't wear much, only the gorgeous and dazzling fire armor is attached to key parts, and her long fiery red hair is covered with a crown of flames in the form of a phoenix.

This look is perfect for a royal lady.

And she is the kind of extremely aggressive royal sister!

"The content of this novel world has finally evolved into something beyond my reach..."

[Name: Longque]

[Title: Flame Concubine]

[Realm: Second-level Heavenly Lord]

[Race: Holy Flame Dragon Bird (gods and demons)]

[Identity: Guardian of the imperial weapon Daxia Dragon Bird]

[Comment: The Holy Flame Dragon Bird clan is one of the top gods and demon clans. They were later conquered by the ancestor of the Yun clan. They have guarded the Imperial Artifact of Great Xia for generations and are now the ninth generation guardians]

In the original setting, the only imperial weapon in Daxia, the Daxia Dragon Bird, was made from materials from the Holy Flame Dragon Bird clan, so the imperial weapon was named Daxia Dragon Bird.

The Holy Flame Dragon Bird clan was once one of the top gods and demon clans, but it was difficult to pass on the bloodline of this clan. The previous generation of Holy Flame Dragon Birds had to sacrifice themselves before the next generation could be born.

Each generation is named by the word "Longque".

Now it has reached the ninth generation!

The founder of the Yun Clan made an agreement when he surrendered to the Holy Flame Dragon Bird. If the Yun Clan declines one day in the future, and the children of the Yun Clan are no match for the Dragon Bird, the contract between the two clans can be terminated.

The Holy Flame Dragon Bird no longer has the responsibility of guarding the imperial weapon, nor does it have the responsibility of guarding Daxia.

Today's Dragon Bird's strength can easily crush Qin Ran. She has been able to get rid of the shackles of the Holy Flame Dragon Bird clan for thousands of years, but she has not left just yet.

It's not that I'm thinking about the old love that has lasted for thousands of years.

But they also want to share a piece of the Great Xia Dragon Luck...

The dragon bird's whole body was bathed in flames.

After her arrival, the champagne-colored roses in the entire courtyard were withering visibly.

The ground beneath her feet was also burned to a dark brown color.

A flash of distress flashed in Xu Ruohan's eyes.
